score_objections.objection: The only china_chips source is a CHIPS Act exchange about domestic manufacturing incentives; the item itself concedes it is 'about domestic chip manufacturing rather than export rules.' Nothing in the sources shows Veasey calling for tighter export controls on chips. His China framing (CHIPS Act, TikTok/CCP concern) is hawkish in tone, which supports a lean but not the strongest position.
